def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    centers=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        v=grid[r][c]
        if v and v!=3: centers.append((r,c,v))
    # Colored centers project their color along the row and column through the marker,

    for r,c,v in centers:
      for j in range(w):
        if grid[r][j]==0: out[r][j]=v
      for i in range(h):
        if grid[i][c]==0: out[i][c]=v
    return out
